detail: Every breathing-rate value is measured while the volunteers wear a N95 respirator, a surgical mask, a visor or a combination of them, which is the manipulation the paper studies; the paper has no mask-free arm, and the model has no input for a face covering, so no protocol can be written without inventing one.
